newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end a notch higher in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end a notch higher in dull trade.

text.p: MADRID, Nov 4 (Reuter) 1615 GMT - Madrid stocks closed slightly higher in dull trade on Monday, with thin range-trading foreseen for the next few sessions because of a lack of market-moving indicators and tomorrow's U.S. election.
* General index rose 0.61 points, 0.16 percent to 376.34
* Telefonica shed 15 pesetas to 2,545, continuing to consolidate after a heady rise. Further gains seen.
* Repsol added 60 pesetas to 4,225, recovering some of recent sharp losses ahead of nine-month results due next week.
"It's been a pretty dull day, and if it weren't for put-throughs, volumes would have been quite thin," said a trader.
With few leading indicators scheduled this week, and many companies not set to report nine-month earnings until next, the outlook for the next few sessions could be similarly lacklustre.
